subject: StratusCloud DPA - redline and signature routing
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratuscloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stratuscloud.com
Date: 2025-07-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: DPA redline for upcoming deployment

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement has asked us to get a signed DPA in place before we spin up the pilot in your US region. We reviewed Redwood's standard DPA and attached a redlined version with a few asks we need clarified:

- Data retention: We redlined a 7-year retention carve-out for historical transactional records — can Redwood confirm feasibility and where that data would be stored?
- SCCs / international transfers: We added language referencing the EU Commission SCCs; please confirm compatibility with your hosting controls.
- Subprocessor notice: We proposed a 14-day advance notice for subprocessor changes (we'd like a slightly longer window than your default).
- HIPAA: We flagged the PHI carve-out for the pilot scope — please confirm whether you can accept HIPAA-specific appendices for an addendum.

Attached: StratusCloud_DPA_redline_20250712.pdf (redline) and StratusCloud_PO_5678.pdf (PO). We are working to close this by EOD 2025-07-18. Can you confirm a routing plan for signature (DocuSign preferred) and whether Redwood needs executive approval for any of the proposed redlines?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Senior Counsel | StratusCloud
alex.turner@stratuscloud.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline for upcoming deployment

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Karthik (sales ops) to review redlines and confirm signature flow. Marcus from security is cc'd to confirm SCCs and SOC 2 scope compatibility.

High level: we typically accept SCCs language and can do a HIPAA appendix for pilot-scoped PHI, but a few of your indemnity and retention edits are outside our standard tolerances — Marissa will call those out.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa to provide line-by-line on the redline (expect by EOD 7/13)
- Marcus to confirm SCCs alignment and any evidence we need to surface (SOC 2 report date, vendor list)
- If acceptable, we will route via DocuSign to the signatories below: Marissa Cole (VP Legal) -> Karthik Iyer (Head, Commercial) -> Alex Turner (StratusCloud). If Marissa cannot sign within the window we will fallback to Soojin or Karthik.

I've attached an internal redline checklist for reference (redline_summary_20250712.xlsx).

— Soojin
So ojin Lee
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratuscloud.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-13T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline for upcoming deployment

Alex / team — reviewed the attached redline and called out the material items below. I've included inline comments in the PDF; summary here: 

1) Retention (7 years): We cannot broadly accept a 7-year retention requirement for all categories. We can agree to a 7-year retention for specific transactional records if StratusCloud identifies the record classes. Otherwise, we propose a compromise: 3 years default with an option for customers to request extended retention via contract schedule.

2) SCCs / Transfers: Marcus confirmed we can adopt the SCCs language you proposed, subject to the same technical and organizational measures detailed in Schedule A. We'll provide the current SOC 2 report (see note) and an excerpt of subprocessors list.

3) Subprocessor notice: 14 days is tight for operational reasons. We can agree to 30 days for non-critical subprocessors, 7 days for emergency changes with prior notice to the customer.

4) Indemnity and Limitation: We are unable to expand indemnity beyond willful misconduct or gross negligence; proposed broad indemnities will need to be narrowed.

We can accept the HIPAA appendix for the pilot provided we finalize the scoping language (documents/data types) — Marcus, please confirm the proposed scoping matrix.

If StratusCloud is comfortable with the compromise above, we will prepare a clean DPA for countersignature and route via DocuSign. If you need any of the above escalated, please identify which clauses are deal-stoppers.

Marissa Cole
VP, Legal | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: DPA redline for upcoming deployment

Marissa / Soojin — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few follow-ups: 

- For retention: StratusCloud can provide a list of the specific transactional records that will require 7-year retention. If Redwood agrees in writing for those classes, we can accept the 3-year default + schedule approach.
- SCCs: happy to accept schedule-level references to the SCCs and to include a SOC 2 attestation delivery milestone (we typically need the latest report within 90 days of signature).
- Indemnity: we can narrow the request — we are primarily seeking coverage for third-party claims tied to data breaches involving StratusCloud-controlled processed data. If Redwood can accept language that ties indemnity to a demonstrated security failure, that would be acceptable.

Procurement notes: PO 5678 has a tentative start date of 2025-08-01 and finance requires a countersigned DPA to release initial payment. Can Redwood confirm who will initiate the DocuSign envelope and the expected ETA for countersignature?

Best,
Alex
